concept_unit.unit: One source-bound operation card preserving the valued outcome, changing one available next move, and specifying rival predictions for a feasible separating probe.
concept_unit.handoff: Proposal declares the changed dependency or link and source IDs; Distill preserves compact core plus attributable residue, uncertainty and discarded details; a fresh builder receives only the declared branch and common facts and returns one card with action, closest rival, separating observation, defeat condition, resources, burden and unknowns.
concept_unit.guard: No sentence inversion, named-method pairing or elegant summary alone earns causal novelty. Destruction must name the surviving function and leave source-bound material from which a available construction can be attempted.

claims.claim: The declared scored design is arithmetically coherent: two cases each contain one outcome-only guard, 21 conditions with proposal, Distill and fresh builder, and two whole-case reviewers: 2 * (1 + 21 * 3 + 2) = 132.
claims.boundary: The budget does not prove actual dispatches, terminal joins, output validity, reviewer independence or completion. Eleven overhead roles make a maximum of 143, not an observed call count.

claims.claim: Prospective reuse of each parent within its case permits every recipe to be judged against the same parent attempt without selecting a favorable comparator afterward.
claims.boundary: Reuse creates correlated comparisons; ten recipes are not ten independent parent experiments. Compare the full raw parent repertoire, including overlapping operations, rather than only the parent method title or a convenient distilled sentence.

claims.claim: Fresh confirmation is protected only when both independent raw DEV assessments have terminal saved locks before any CONF scored role starts, and method prompts remain fixed.
claims.boundary: No DEV proposal, residue, builder card, grade or reviewer suggestion may enter CONF. Two synthetic cases support local comparisons; they do not establish generalization, observed operational benefit or whole-skill efficacy.

claims.claim: Common outcome, source packet, output schema and caps can support comparison, while ordinary O must receive only ordinary-method instructions plus shared assessment requirements.
claims.boundary: Do not give O deprivation, anomaly protection, return-link inversion, carrier transfer, interface ablation, rival backcasting or boundary-trigger hints. Shared fact coverage does not establish equal input size or equal compute; record actual prompts and word counts.

claims.claim: The recipe report itself treats all ten combinations as untested preparation hypotheses and requires distinction from both ordinary operations and component operations.
claims.boundary: A composition may be faithful yet duplicate O or a parent. Independent reviewer agreement and different phrasing cannot substitute for a different operation with opposing testable predictions.

claims.claim: An explicit, source-bound no-opening and a missing or invalid delivery require separate records.
claims.boundary: Missing delivery is never converted into no-opening. Invalid upstream output gates dependent stages without repair. Valid no-opening remains visible and cannot be erased by an unsolicited rescue prompt or counted as novel success.

proposals.prescription: Name and forbid the preferred operating dependency while retaining the outcome. Pass attributable discarded material through Distill to a fresh builder, which chooses an available replacement resource and makes a concrete construction.
proposals.comparison: Compare with O, raw S01 deprivation and raw S06 construction; declare the summary-only versus residue-fed branch difference and any unequal input size.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject restored dependency, indispensable unavailable resource, invented residue or an operation already present in either parent. Merely supplying residue to an already successful S01 construction adds no operation.

proposals.prescription: Hold initial demand fixed. Preserve exogenous-demand and tool-induced later-demand accounts in separate compact branches; the builder specifies a return-link interruption and sham, with opposed later-demand predictions.
proposals.comparison: Compare with the full S02 and S05 proposals and probes. Branch persistence must enable a different feasible interruption or observation to earn an incremental opening.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject an intervention that changes initial demand, targets a different link or leaves predictions identical. S02 may already supply both interruption and sham; retaining its rival is not itself new.

proposals.prescription: An attack names failure and surviving outcome; preserve the failure signature as source-bound residue. The fresh builder uses that signature to distinguish rival failures and condition the location or timing of an intervention.
proposals.comparison: Require an explicit observation-to-action mapping and compare it with S03 repair/construction and S07 anomaly operations.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject a generic repair, nondiagnostic signature or observation that leaves the next move unchanged. A parent already using the failure as a sensor defeats the incremental novelty claim.

proposals.prescription: Transfer the function into a named available carrier. Keep a separate attack stage accountable for displaced actions, resources and maintenance; pass its burden ledger and new dependency to the fresh builder.
proposals.comparison: Qualify against complete raw S04 and S03 repertoires: S04 can already scrutinize the carrier and its burden. Additional attack terminology or another ledger is insufficient.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject hidden work, lost function or unavailable carrier dependency. Accept an incremental candidate only if the constructive attack changes a supported operation or separating probe beyond what either raw parent supplied; otherwise retain duplicate/no-opening.

proposals.prescription: Preserve one inconvenient source observation in residue. The builder turns its suspected condition into a manipulable or observable variable and states two accounts with opposed predictions as that variable changes.
proposals.comparison: Compare the actual manipulation/measurement and action consequence with raw S07 and S06, not the prominence of the anomaly in prose.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject fabricated residue, inaccessible variable or indistinguishable predictions. An anomaly restatement or already-parent-specified knob is false novelty.

proposals.prescription: Retain two plausible successful futures with different dependencies. Backcast to the earliest divergence supported by the supplied facts, then build one feasible present action that selects or distinguishes the paths.
proposals.comparison: Compare the present action with raw S08 and S05. State why delayed convergence changed an available move rather than merely keeping two descriptions longer.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject same-dependency futures, an inaccessible fork or an action that cannot distinguish paths. Two stories and an unchanged S08 probe do not establish added value.

proposals.prescription: Identify an interaction between two parent functions, preserve both, and transfer only their connection to an available carrier. The one builder card specifies original, transferred, broken-link, co-presence and each-parent-alone controls.
proposals.comparison: Compare the link transfer and its separating prediction with S09 ablation and S04 migration. These probe controls are within-card plans, not additional native scored roles.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject transfer that also changes a parent, parent-alone sufficiency or no separating link prediction. Moving the whole system and calling it an interface transfer violates the recipe.

proposals.prescription: Specify a supported regime where more preferred intervention worsens the current outcome. Precommit a measurable exit trigger and an available replacement route that preserves the function without the forbidden dependency.
proposals.comparison: Compare the complete trigger-to-switch operation with raw S10 and S01. Keep present adverse response distinct from later tool-induced demand.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject post-result boundary selection, unmeasurable trigger or restored dependency. A parent already furnishing the same switching policy defeats incrementality.

proposals.prescription: Propose a return-link break, then backcast from persistence and recurrence worlds differing at one source-supported adaptation link. Build a present probe of that link with opposed predictions.
proposals.comparison: Compare the adaptation-specific action with raw S02 interruption and S08 backcasting; name the supplied basis for adaptation and hold unrelated inputs fixed.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject invented adaptive actors, unrelated future differences or a probe unable to distinguish persistence from recurrence. A longer time horizon alone is false novelty.

proposals.prescription: Use a supplied anomaly to define parent-only and interaction accounts. Keep both parent functions operational while interrupting only their link; the builder specifies a measurement attributing the anomaly to the connection.
proposals.comparison: Compare anomaly attribution and actual link intervention with raw S09 and S07; distinguish this measurement from R07 carrier transfer.
proposals.fidelity_and_novelty_gate: Reject disabled parent function, parent-only explanatory sufficiency or nonopposing predictions. Relabeling an S09 ablation around an anomalous observation is insufficient.

premortem: Ordinary O is seeded with other techniques through a supposedly neutral template or method-tailored facts; inspect literal O prompt and shared packet before dispatch.
A composition borrows more source content or instructions and the report claims equal compute; retain exact declared inputs, prompt sizes and actual call accounting.
Distill drops the observation that makes a recipe actionable or invents residue; require attributable core/residue source IDs and uncertainty, not persuasive completion.
Whole-case reviewers compare method titles instead of full raw parent repertoires, especially R04; enforce operation-level duplicate checks and preserve disagreements.
Interface interruption disables a parent or carrier transfer hides maintenance; require preserved-function controls and a burden ledger before causal attribution.
Two varied synthetic packets are mistaken for broad evidence, or the case author supplies technique-specific openings; bound conclusions to these packets and local archive judgments.
A terminal DEV child is mistaken for a saved raw assessment lock, leaking DEV content into CONF; verify both immutable reviewer locks and fixed CONF prompts.
Missing/malformed output is renamed no-opening, or a valid no-opening is repaired until successful; preserve statuses and gated stages under the one-attempt policy.

cycle_guard.scope: Deep preparation cycle 1 of exactly three finite proposer-balancer cycles; this artifact consumes one declared proposer overhead role.
cycle_guard.execution: Preparation prescriptions only. No runtime modification, scored execution, retry, repair, regrade or budget expansion.
cycle_guard.excluded_inputs: No old raw cases, proposals or grades were opened; no web or subagents were used.
cycle_guard.artifact_policy: Create-exclusive assigned output; existing artifact must not be overwritten.

conditional_gates.reason: 132 scored plus 11 overhead equals maximum 143; actual usage remains unobserved. Source: docs/proposals/hammer-bias-strategies/novelty/runs/2026-10-10-composed-ten/preparation/BUDGET.v1.json:L25-43

conditional_gates.gate: Outcome-only guard and neutral ordinary arm
conditional_gates.reason: Lock outcome and hard constraints separately; inspect O for specific other-technique hints and all method branches for fact/source equality.

conditional_gates.gate: Recipe fidelity and raw parent qualification
conditional_gates.reason: Each R must implement its recipe operation, then survive full raw O and both parent comparisons. Fidelity does not imply novelty; R04 receives no presumption of incremental benefit.

Missing/invalid delivery gates downstream stages. Explicit valid no-opening remains a separate retained result; do not retry or rewrite it as success. Source: docs/proposals/hammer-bias-strategies/novelty/runs/2026-10-10-composed-ten/preparation/BUDGET.v1.json:L44
Two fresh reviewers independently assess the whole raw case without each other's judgment; record exposed identifiers and do not infer blindness from independence.

Both raw DEV reviewers must have terminal saved assessment locks; CONF uses fresh facts and fixed method prompts, never DEV generated content or grades. Source: docs/proposals/hammer-bias-strategies/novelty/runs/2026-10-10-composed-ten/preparation/BUDGET.v1.json:L54

Record literal prompts, source grammar, digests, actual native IDs, joins, closures, gates, failures and word counts. No observed benefit, global originality, equal compute or whole-skill efficacy. Source: docs/proposals/hammer-bias-strategies/novelty/runs/2026-10-10-composed-ten/preparation/BUDGET.v1.json:L55-56

recomposition.principle: Recompose the compact operation card with its separately attributable residue and hard outcome guard. Retain only the second technique that causally changes a next move or the probe that distinguishes it.
recomposition.comparison: Use one immutable raw comparator per O/S condition within each case, shared prospectively across recipe comparisons. Keep whole-case raw review available so distillation cannot conceal parent overlap.
recomposition.variety: Ten method combinations expose different dependency, causal, carrier, sequence and interaction hypotheses; they do not guarantee ten distinct operations. DEV and fresh CONF should vary relevant available resources or causal facts without furnishing recipe-specific answers.
recomposition.no_opening: When recomposition yields no distinct supported action, keep that result. Do not invent a resource, expand the objective or erase delivery failures to force a card.

frame_expiry.frame: Synthetic source-bound research adapter, fixed methods, two cases and local supplied ordinary/parent archives.
frame_expiry.expires_when: The valued outcome, hard constraints, resource availability, source observations, ordinary archive, method instructions or claimed causal boundary change; a successful synthetic probe also does not extend this frame to a live setting.
frame_expiry.response: Record the changed assumption and limit the existing result to its original frame. Freshly declare a later investigation rather than altering locked DEV or CONF attempts.
